HistoryEmptyBody: Scanned and manually selected items will appear here.
ScannerReadyDetail: RatScanner is running normally and can detect items from the configured game display.
ScannerPausedDetail: Scanning is turned off. Enable name or icon scanning in Settings to resume.
DisplayMissing: The configured display could not be found.
InvalidDisplayConfig: The custom game display configuration is invalid.
GameOnDifferentDisplay: Escape from Tarkov is on a different display than the one configured.
GameSpansDisplays: The game window spans multiple displays.
DisplayScaleUnknown: Display scaling could not be determined for the configured screen.
DisplayUnavailable: The configured game display is not available for scanning.
MapViewerInstructions: Use the mouse wheel to zoom and drag to pan.
GameDisplayDescription: Select the display where Escape from Tarkov runs.
UseCustomGameResolutionDescription: Override the detected game viewport for windowed mode or nonstandard game configurations.
CustomViewportHelp: These values represent the game client area used to scale item detection, not the full monitor.
OverrideDisplayScalingDescription: Use only when Windows reports incorrect scaling, such as with a virtual or remote display.
GameDisplayUnavailableError: Select an available game display before saving.
CustomResolutionValidation: Enter a resolution from {0} × {1} through {2} × {3} with a reasonable aspect ratio.
GameDisplayStatusSaved: Tarkov is not running. Using the saved {0}.
GameDisplayStatusPrimary: Tarkov is not running. Using {0} as the safe fallback.
GameDisplayStatusFallback: No primary display was reported. Using {0}.
GameDisplayStatusUnavailable: The saved display is unavailable. RatScanner is safely using {0}; save to confirm this replacement.
GameDisplayStatusMoved: The game window is on {0}, which differs from the saved selection. RatScanner is using the game window for this session.
GameDisplayStatusSpanning: The game window spans displays. RatScanner is using {0}, which contains most of the window.
GameDisplayStatusDpi: Windows did not report reliable scaling for {0}. Verify the detected values or use the advanced override.
GameDisplayStatusInvalidCustom: The custom game display values are invalid. Automatic values remain active until they are corrected.
GameDisplayStatusNone: No usable display was detected. Reconnect a display and refresh detection.
GameModeSwitchFailed: RatScanner could not switch game mode. The previous mode is still active.
BackendIoWarning: Some features may not work properly or may be unsupported on TarkovTracker.io. Migrate to TarkovTracker.org for full functionality.
BackendIoWarningLink: Open TarkovTracker.org to sign in or create an account
CreditsMaintainedBy: Maintained by TarkovTracker.org (GitHub: tarkovtracker-org). Use this page’s links for support with this build.

RecNoMarketValue: No current market or trader value is available.
RecNoTraderOffer: No comparable trader offer is available.
RecTraderMeetsOrExceeds: The trader offer meets or exceeds the current market value.
RecFirMixed: {0} must be found in raid; {1} can be non-FIR.
RecFirRequired: Requires found in raid (confirm FIR on the item — visual FIR detection is not available yet).
RecNonFirOk: Non-FIR is OK for these needs.
RecCraftableFir: Craftable in hideout (crafted items are always found in raid).
RecCraftOrBarter: Can be crafted ({0}) or bartered for ({1}).
RecCraftOnly: Can be crafted in hideout ({0} recipe(s); output is always FIR).
JumpShowUIDescription: Opens the main interface of RatScanner
JumpShowMinimalUIDescription: Opens the minimal interface of RatScanner
JumpShowOverlayDescription: Opens the interactive overlay of RatScanner
SettingSaveFailed: This setting could not be saved. The previous value was restored.
CustomResolutionNumbersValidation: Enter positive whole numbers for width and height.
CustomResolutionDisplayValidation: The selected display supports up to {0} × {1} pixels. Choose a capture viewport within those bounds.
InterfaceLanguageDescription: Changes the language used by the RatScanner interface.
TooltipDelayDescription: Choose how long scan tooltips stay visible.
DiagnosticsDescription: Technical logging for troubleshooting. Leave this off during normal use.
NameScanningDescription: Recognize item names from inspection windows.
NameScanLanguageDescription: Match the language used by item names in Escape from Tarkov.
IconScanningDescription: Recognize inventory items from their icons.
HotkeyCaptureDescription: Select the button, then press the desired keyboard and mouse combination. Escape cancels.
ScanningStatusDescription: At least one scanning method must be enabled for automatic detection.
MinimalUiContentDescription: Choose the details shown in the compact window.
TrackingDisplayDescription: Choose which quest, hideout, Kappa, and team needs appear in scan results.
TeamPermissionDescription: Permissions: GP read  ·  TP for teammates  ·  No WP write
DisconnectConfirmMessage: Progress synchronization will stop and the stored API key will be removed.
TarkovTrackerIntro: Connect your accounts to synchronize task progress.
ChangeConnectionSafety: Your existing connection stays active until the new key is verified.
SourceSharedNote: PvP and PvE each require their corresponding API key.
PveRequiresOrg: Requires a TarkovTracker.org PvE API key.
TrackerNotConnectedPve: TarkovTracker.org is not connected for PvE.
TrackerNotConnectedPvp: No TarkovTracker connection is configured for PvP.
CredentialSaveFailed: The verified key could not be saved. The previous key is still configured.
CredentialRemoveFailed: The key could not be removed. The existing connection is unchanged.
CredentialInvalid: The API key is invalid, expired, or was rejected.
CredentialWrongMode: This key is not valid for {0}. Create a key for the matching game mode.
CredentialMissingPermissions: Add these required permissions to the key: {0}.
CredentialMissingPermissionGeneric: The key is missing a required progress-read permission.
CredentialRateLimited: TarkovTracker rate-limited the test. Wait briefly and try again.
CredentialServiceUnavailable: TarkovTracker is temporarily unavailable. The entered key was not saved.
CredentialNetworkError: RatScanner could not reach TarkovTracker. Check the connection and retry.
CredentialUnexpectedResponse: TarkovTracker returned an unexpected response. The entered key was not saved.
ReadyToScanDescription: Inspect or click an item in Escape from Tarkov, or search above.
LowConfidenceDescription: This may not be the correct item. Confirm it or search for another match.
FirRequiredTooltip: At least one remaining need requires found in raid. Confirm FIR on the item yourself — automatic FIR icon detection is not implemented yet.
ConfirmFir: Confirm the checkmark on the item (not detected automatically)
CraftableTooltip: Hideout craft products are always found in raid.
BarterableTooltip: Trader barter offers this item (not FIR unless noted elsewhere).
FleaMarketPaysMore: Flea market pays {0} more than selling to {1}
